==Airlines and destinations==
===Passenger===
In response to the [[Russian invasion of Ukraine]] in February 2022, many countries have moved to ban Russian airlines from their air space and many countries ban airlines from flying in and out of Russian airspace. Other airlines from the [[European Union]], [[North America]], the [[United Kingdom]], [[Switzerland]], [[Norway]], [[Iceland]], [[South Korea]], [[Japan]], [[Taiwan]] and [[Singapore]] have indefinitely suspended their services to Domodedovo.{{citation needed|date=July 2026}}

The following airlines operate regular scheduled and charter services to and from Domodedovo:
